metadata.description: Optional extensions for oh-my-pi: provider integrations, inference-engine telemetry, native magic-keyword routing and one-shot expert review.

plugins.name: nous-portal
plugins.description: Adds Nous Portal Device OAuth, /login integration and dynamic model discovery.

plugins.name: free-models
plugins.description: Picks provider-confirmed free models from live sources and diagnoses stale catalog entries.

plugins.name: llm-metrics
plugins.description: vLLM and SGLang queue, throughput, speculative-decoding and KV-cache telemetry for the OMP status line.

plugins.name: magic-router
plugins.description: Routes interactive prompts and OMP paste attachments to native magic keywords with deterministic classification, session toggle and native-gradient status.

plugins.name: expert-review
plugins.description: Advisor review then original-model adjudication and minimal apply.
